phases.name: Close the email-collision enumeration oracle end-to-end

steps.name: Atomic claim+create with narrow 23505 catch; rewire handler to uniform refusal
criteria: Greens all three RED scenarios in bootstrap-claim-enumeration-oracle.feature: colliding email refused byte-identically to expired/unknown (US-01); token stays unconsumed on collision (US-02); retry with a fresh email then succeeds (US-02).

Keeps the US-03 regression scenario green AND the entire us-05-bootstrap.feature net green (13/13): happy claim seeds workspace + first instance_admin, used/expired/unknown token refusals stay byte-identical.

New code: Store::claim_bootstrap_and_create_workspace runs ONE tx = guarded-UPDATE consume of bootstrap_tokens (0 rows -> Refused, rollback) + the six workspace-seed INSERTs + the instance_admins ON CONFLICT seed; the users INSERT is wrapped so a SQLSTATE-23505 UNIQUE violation is caught SPECIFICALLY -> EmailCollision (whole tx rolls back, token UNCONSUMED); any other error propagates as StoreError. Returns BootstrapClaimOutcome { Consumed { workspace_id, user_id }, Refused, EmailCollision }. Replaces the panicking DISTILL scaffold.

Caller-preservation: extract the six seed INSERTs into a private helper (e.g. seed_initial_workspace(&mut tx, ...)) shared by BOTH the existing create_initial_workspace (signature + ~9 callers UNCHANGED) and the new method. No deletion of create_initial_workspace, no duplicated INSERT SQL.

Handler rewire (crates/foundry-app/src/bootstrap.rs): the POST claim path hashes the password then calls claim_bootstrap_and_create_workspace and matches Consumed -> insert session + 303 /dashboard; Refused | EmailCollision -> bootstrap_refusal_page() (byte-identical, status 200, NEVER 500); Err(StoreError) -> the existing 500 path. Password hashing stays OUTSIDE the tx.

NFR-3 narrow-catch pinned by a store-scope unit test: a colliding email yields EmailCollision with the token row still used_at IS NULL; a bad token yields Refused; a happy path yields Consumed with the seed rows present. Store-scope mutation must kill a mutant that broadens the 23505 catch.

Remove the __SCAFFOLD__ marker from the store method. No dead/commented-out code (pre-stable policy). Run cargo xtask check-arch if the handler/store boundary changed (no new LAYER-1e line expected — issuance resolves nothing new).
steps.scenario_name: All scenarios (US-01 collision byte-identity, US-02 unconsumed + reusable, US-03 regression)
